summary: four walled-wave cases red on win32 with ENOENT at a worktree's .git and then an undefined verdict, so a wall loses the facts artifact

per.section: The tick verdict — one facts artifact

acceptance: a wave walled by a win32 worktree path reports the verdict naming the spans it shipped, rather than throwing out past it
notes: Windows-lane reds, one family: "a recorded ledger refusal outranks a slot leg's throw" and "a walled wave reports every wall it held" fail with `ENOENT ... boom-b\.git`, then two cases fail `expected undefined` where a verdict was due. Every tick that runs a phase writes one verdict, so the undefined is the defect and the ENOENT its likely cause. Shares tests/Dispatcher.test.ts with two siblings, which serializes the three. No tests[]: win32-only, so nothing reds on the base.
